observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 193.» (L20) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 53: 10 stands beside the second line of the title, 15 beside L12.
body L6-L8: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT LIII.» is centred, the title is set as a paragraph of two lines, the second indented.
body L9: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic; with chapter 53 the letters begin again at a.
body L11, L17: the m of «sume» is printed broken, like ni; the e after the rr of «correctis» is printed broken, like c.
notes_left L5, L6: «365ᵈ 5ʰ 46ᵐ 24ˢ» and «5ʰ 46ᵐ 24ˢ» are written with small raised italic d, h, m and s.
notes_left L8: the note ends with a comma, «12,»; kept as printed.

notes_right L1: the fraction (3 2/5)/360 is set in two lines, with the small fraction 2/5 in its numerator; the line stands 5.3 pt lower than the first line of the left column, and the next line follows at 13.8 pt, to make room for the fraction.
body L8: a speck stands before «quem» in the title, at the height of the tops of the letters; it is not a sign.
body L10, L11: the dash before «sume» (8.5 pt) is printed shorter and thinner than the dash before «et hoc» (10.3 pt); a speck stands under the o of «hoc».
body L25: the 7 of «270°» is printed broken, its stroke reduced to a blot; read as 270 between «180°» and «360°».
notes_left L1: the hyphen of «legen-» is printed short and round (1.7 pt), like a point.
notes_right L4: the closing parenthesis of «(6)» is printed short.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
